powers: If you are the only character at your location, you may reveal a card that has the Poison trait or recharge a card to add 1d6 (☐ or your Charisma skill) and the Poison trait to your combat check (☐ or your Acrobatics or Stealth check).
You may evade your encounter. (☐ Then you may either examine the top card of your location deck or move.)

roles.name: Ninjutsu Master
powers: If you are the only character at your location, you may reveal a card that has the Poison trait or recharge a card to add 1d6 (☐ or your Charisma skill) and the Poison trait to your combat check (☐ or your Acrobatics or Stealth check).
You may evade your encounter. (☐ Then you may either examine the top card of your location deck or move.) (☐ Then you may shuffle your location deck.)
☐ On your check that invokes the Finesse or Poison trait, you gain the skill Melee: Dexterity +3.
☐ When you defeat a henchman that allows you to attempt to close your location, you may examine your location deck before choosing whether to do so (☐ and add 4 to your checks to do so).
☐ You may treat your powers and favored card type as if the word "Poison" were "Arcane". (☐ You gain the skill Arcane: Charisma +2.)
☐ When an item that has the Poison trait requires you to banish or bury a card from your hand or deck, you may discard that card instead.

roles.name: Saboteur
powers: If you are the only character at your location, you may reveal a card that has the Poison trait or recharge a card to add 1d6 (☐ or your Charisma skill) and the Poison trait to your combat check (☐ or your Acrobatics or Stealth check) (☐ or your check to defeat a barrier or close a location).
You may evade your encounter. (☐ Then you may either examine the top card of your location deck or move.) (☐ If you evaded a non-villain barrier, you may put it on the bottom of its location deck.)
☐ When a character at your location acquires a weapon, an armor, or an item (☐ or any boon), she may banish it to shuffle a random card from her discard pile into her deck.
☐ When a character at another location attempts a combat check, you may recharge a card to add 1d4 (☐ and add 2 if the card has the Poison trait).
☐ When you defeat a barrier, you may draw a blessing from the box then discard a card.
